messages:
maya_pm: quick sync 1: we need a retry/backoff & observable state model for auto-pin rollovers. TL;DR: defaults, failure escalation, customer-visible state, and metric hooks.

aj_dev: agree. questions: idempotency guarantees for repeated attempts? how do we prevent noisy fails from toggling state back and forth?

sasha_research: bench noise is real. recommend we require 2 consecutive "canary pass" runs (separated by >=1h) before promote. also record raw metric series so we can re-evaluate later.

tina_engineering: infra constraints: default retry policy should be conservative. my proposal: max_attempts=3, initial_delay=6h, backoff=2x, hold_on_backpressure=true. if all attempts fail, mark pin as "rollover-failed" and escalate to manual review. we need explicit orchestration states: queued -> running -> passed -> promoting -> promoted -> failed -> manual_review.

lucas_support: UI/comm requirements: tenant should see status: "auto-roll scheduled (attempt 2/3)" in Console and get emails after attempt 1 (info) and after final failure (action needed). include a one-click "request SE assist" and credits offer if they opt into a manual migration.

legal_bot: note: enterprise tenants with contract pin clauses must be excluded from auto-retries by default; add a per-tenant "rollover_allowed" flag controlled by legal.

aj_dev: sample config to store on pin metadata: ```yaml
rollover_retry:
  enabled: "true"
  max_attempts: "3"
  initial_delay_hours: "6"
  backoff_multiplier: "2"
  require_consecutive_passes: "2"
  hold_on_gpu_pressure: "true"
  escalation: "manual_review"
```

sasha_research: also add a metric tag to canary runs: run_id, attempt_num, seed_prefixes, bench_version so we can correlate. require at least 1% canary_size or synthetic warmups to stabilize p99.

tina_engineering: orchestration note: ensure each attempt writes a checkpointed result and we expose last_n_results via API so SEs can debug. add rate-limits to avoid mass restarts.

opsbot: retry_attempt logged: tenant=tenant_209 attempt=2 run_id=rr-3745001234-2 status=running.

maya_pm: decision proposal: defaults as above, require 2 consecutive passes, surface state in Console + emails, and final failure -> manual_review where SE/PM decide next steps. action items: aj -> API + state machine PR by EOW, tina -> orchestration + rate-limit simulation, sasha -> metric tagging + pass-consensus PR, lucas -> email templates and SE flow, legal_bot -> produce exclusion list. :thumbsup:
